_comment: Immutable verified target facts only; no profile data, credentials or guessed install paths. Documented native paths/ExecStart remain unverified until remote_deploy.py checks the running service. Contract-verified values come from recorded target probes; parent-probe values describe reachability only, not a credentialed login.

do_not_touch: any other service on this host besides sub2api2m + its dedicated postgres/redis

ssh._route_note: Primary route is the public IP per live parent reachability probe (mesh route returned 'No route to host'). Mesh IP is retained only as a known_hosts alias for the SAME pinned host identity, never a dynamic/unpinned fallback host.

native._warning: Exact ExecStart/install/binary path is explicitly NOT verified per contract. remote_deploy.py MUST discover the live binary path from the running sub2api.service MainPID (/proc/<pid>/exe) and MUST NOT assume /opt/sub2api or any other guessed path. The root-protected approved profile's native.binary_path is only accepted after it is confirmed equal to this live discovery.

_pinned_key_source: Recorded verified target SSH host identities; see FORK.md.
